verdict.rationale: CockroachDB's standard SQL API (inherently supporting multi-row INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) and its backup/restore and changefeed features imply bulk data operations, and the MCP server lets an AI agent execute statements and insert rows via natural language. However, no evidence explicitly documents batch/bulk operation support (e.g., IMPORT, batched writes, or bulk API semantics) for AI-driven workflows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk/batch operation APIs or IMPORT tooling, and evidence that the MCP/agent interface supports operating on many items in a single call rather than one at a time.
